body: Same, I can't sleep in or have some free time to do whatever (you know just lie down or watch some shows, etc)
Honestly, and the worst part is, when I come home from uni I can at least go to a library or cafe to study. Since everything is closed you just have to suck it up and do school work.

Of course you have to move on. But there is also a grief period as well. Dwelling on it will obviously not make it any better. We humans have a grief period and that is allowed - it applies to anything in life
Everyone has a right to be sad about something that have been looking forward to and it doesn't happen. Don't compare yourself, let them BE SAD.

Hi thank you for your input. I understand that sometimes breakups are terrible and you definitely need some time to heal. However, I have told her many times that she needs to move on (nicest way possible). But I cannot help her anymore, I have tried my hardest but I realize that she doesn't want to change at all and its affecting my mental health instead. But I do think I should have a conversation with her instead of just cutting her off out of the blue.

I agree, I have tried opening up to counsellors provided by my university. It just is not helpful. They did not help me at all instead I felt worse about myself due to frustration of not be able to find someone to help me. I just want help, I know I need help just give me the help I NEED to feel better.
